rolling_brier_meta.map_scope_note: Points use the prequential per-fold calibration layer (fit on prior OOF folds only); the pooled all-OOF Platt map is the serving layer and is not in this series.

feature_importance.reading: model_weight[f] = sum(member_shares[m] * member_profiles[m][f]) over members m; all percentages. A concentrated member share means the MODEL WEIGHT column is that member's own importance profile
